# Default User Permissions

Complete list of default permissions granted to all users.


 Permissions User View All Users ✅ View user Profile ✅ View user Designs ✅ View user Badges ✅ View user Activity ✅ View Keys ✅ View Catalog ✅ Invite Users ✅ Update User Profile ❌ Delete a user account ❌ Create a new user ❌ Leave a Team ❌ View Roles ❌ Assign roles to team members ❌ Assign keys and keychains to the team members ❌ *Organization Owner Permissions marked with * apply only if you are the owner of the organization. Customizable Permissions Default permissions can be easily customized by simply creating your own keychains and roles.
